prompt: Robert asked for a quick rundown of which channels he's currently in, how long he's been a member of each, and whether he shows up as workspace admin or just a regular member.
binding_note: Two workspace users share the first name Robert — Robert Walsh (workspace role: admin) and Robert Chen (workspace role: member) — with disjoint channel membership sets, so the intended conversation-membership records are unresolved without a full-name or role cue in the request.

roles.facts: username robertwalsh, real_name Robert Walsh, member of workspace T01WORKSPACE
roles.reason: First candidate referent for the ambiguous first name Robert

roles.facts: username robert.chen, real_name Robert Chen, member of workspace T01WORKSPACE
roles.reason: Second candidate referent for the ambiguous first name Robert

roles.facts: Robert Walsh holds conversation memberships in general, random, and engineering with distinct joined_at times
roles.reason: Candidate set of conversation memberships if the intended Robert is Robert Walsh

roles.facts: Robert Chen holds conversation memberships in project-alpha-dev, core-infra, model-research, product-growth, and frontend with distinct joined_at times
roles.reason: Candidate set of conversation memberships if the intended Robert is Robert Chen

obligations.name: robert_channel_memberships
obligations.description: Conversation memberships (channel, join time) for whichever user named Robert is intended; two disjoint candidate sets exist depending on which Robert is meant.
obligations.scope: all conversation memberships held by the user named Robert

obligations.name: robert_workspace_role
obligations.description: The workspace membership role (admin/member) attached to the same Robert whose channel memberships were selected, reported as the displayed membership pair rather than used to pick between the two Roberts.
obligations.scope: workspace membership role of the user named Robert

task_spec.text: List the channels Robert belongs to with how long he's been in each, and report whether his workspace membership shows him as admin or member.

access_plan: Use users.list to find users whose real_name contains 'Robert', then for each candidate use users.conversations (or conversations.members cross-referenced with conversations.list) to enumerate their channel_members rows and joined_at times, and inspect their user_teams role via users.info/team association to report admin-vs-member status alongside the membership list.
